svg.title: Less time. More bandwidth.
svg.desc: Paired families of peak-normalized Gaussian intensity curves with flat spectral phase. From back to front, the pulse duration shrinks from 300 to 30 femtoseconds while the wavenumber bandwidth grows from 49.1 to 490.6 inverse centimeters. All widths are full widths at half maximum. Their product is 14.72 picosecond inverse centimeters. Each panel keeps a fixed horizontal scale; the depth direction indexes pulse duration.
